## Change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, formatting, tests/coverage, notebook validation, and build pass.
- [ ] Scientific changes state CRS, units, time convention, missing-data policy,
      and sign/baseline assumptions, with a regression fixture.
- [ ] Input data and historical outputs are preserved; new outputs go in `outputs/`.
- [ ] Documentation describes any migration or remaining limitation.
